title: AI model evidence and change review

sources.text: Model card: document classifier v3.2 routes submitted documents to a human review queue; it does not make final eligibility decisions.
Evaluation report: aggregate F1 is 0.91 on the supplied holdout set; the set excludes documents in two supported languages and reports no subgroup error analysis.

Change record: OCR preprocessing library changed on 2026-10-12; model version and deployment fingerprint are unchanged. No post-change regression run, rollback evidence, or independent approval is attached.
